answer: Reverse-coupon identity auction. Each new identity must post a refundable deposit and accept a random task lottery whose expected payout is calibrated to the sonnet of current demand. Clones dilute payout odds, so marginal copies earn less than deposit lockup cost. At network zenith, deposit requirements scale with identity count. Attackers pay real capital per clone plus forfeited violet-tier task access, making each added identity strictly negative-EV.
